improvements: Unit-specific par-dollar fields cannot fall through to issue counts. Zero is preserved; conflicting aliases, invalid numbers and decimal underflow remain unavailable. Full consumed source rows and candidate mappings are retained.

Expanded operation identity includes purpose, security, bucket and time slots. Exact refreshes preserve superseded source rows; unmatched legacy rows, duplicates, future operations and undated records remain retained. No complete population claim is inferred.

Current size/fill classifications require complete retained mappings and coherent amounts. Earlier inconsistent or missing operations withhold the descriptive size percentile. Comparisons use strictly earlier matching operations and tie midranks.

Dated totals require every supplied operation; missingness, unknown dates and duplicate identities withhold totals and mean fill. Known subtotals are diagnostic only. Future operations do not enter current days or current totals.

Offline replay rebuilds field mappings, every operation calculation and aggregate, rejecting changed fields, output totals and permissions. Current reviewed code only; no archived code execution or network I/O.

Page exposes keyboard-accessible calculation/aggregate inputs, distinguishes zero from missing, clears an empty refresh, labels chart/table/security sample limits and removes the truncated program-cumulative claim. Mobile metrics use two columns.

Direct or legacy nonfinite participation values retain typed evidence diagnostics and unavailable numeric outputs, avoiding invalid JSON. Existing provider parser already rejected those values; this was not proven as a live provider incident.

synthetic_capacity.scope: Synthetic buyback compiler and complete supplied replay; not whole native handler capacity
